subject: Application: Finance & Controlling Intern (20 h/week, from December)
paragraphs: Example Bank's push to automate its controlling reports is exactly the kind of work I want to contribute to while finishing my Business and Economics degree. Your internship combines reporting, Excel modelling and close work with business units, and that is where I can add value from day one.

At Example Trading GmbH I prepared the monthly sales, margin and forecast reports for management. I rebuilt our pricing model in Excel, which cut proposal preparation time by 60%, and I kept a monthly sales target of EUR 50,000 on track by reading the numbers early and acting on them. I also reconciled incoming payments with our accounting team every month, so I know how operational numbers end up in the books.

As project lead in a student consulting club I ran a six-person market-entry study for a local start-up and presented the results to its founders. It taught me to structure an open question, split the work and deliver on a fixed deadline, which matters in a controlling team at month-end. I am comfortable presenting numbers to people who are not analysts and turning their questions into clear follow-up analyses.

I am available from December for 20 hours per week in Vienna and can be flexible about which days. I speak German natively and English at C1 level. I would be glad to discuss how I can support your team.
